main_text.p: juxta R. Sal. vel צֹאַת אוֹנִים Excrementum columbarum, juxta Kimchium. Chaldæus, קְבָא דְזַכַּל מִפְקַת יוֹנֵיא[?] Cabus fimi excrementi colombarum. Est autem vox legenda pro חֲרִיּוֹנִים : vide חָרַר .

דְּבָא m. Sermo, juxta quosdam: וּכְיָמֶיךָ דְּבָאֲךָ Et sicut dies tui, sic sermo tuus, Deut.33.25. id est, Quamdiu vives, iamdiu sermo de te erit, & sermone hominum celebraberis. Vel Robur, Fortitudo (quod Chaldæus secutus) pro, Juxta annos vitæ tuæ semper idem erit robur tuum, ut juventutis, ita senectutis robur firmum erit. Hæc communior interpretatio, teste Kimchio.

דָּבַב Loqui: Particip. דּוֹבֵב שִׂפְתֵי יְשֵׁנִים Loquitur labiis dormientium, Cant.7.9. hoc est, בִּשְׂפָתַי Per labia facit ut etiam dormientes loquantur. Sic convenit cum Particip. præcedente הוֹלֵךְ : Si דּוֹבֵב accipiatur ex Pihel sive Pohel, tunc Prater. erit pro Part. מְדוֹבֵב .
דִּבָּרָה f. Infamia, Fama mala: Constr. דִּבַּת הָאָרֶץ Infamiam terræ, Numer.13.33. Aff. וְדִבָּתְךָ Et infamia tua, Prov.25.10.
דֹּב com. Ursus, Ursa: דֹּב אֹרֵב Ursus insidians, Thren.3.9. Plural. כְּדֻבִּים Sicut ursi, Jef.95.11. Fœm. שְׁתַּיִם דֻּבִּים Duæ ursæ, 2.Reg.2.25. Chald. לְדֹב Ursro[?], Dan.7.5.
דְּבַח Chald. Sacrificare. Part. דִּבְחִין Sacrificantes, Esr.6.3. ex Hebræo זָבַח commutatis ז & ד .

דֻּבַּךְ Chald: Ordo, Series, Strues lapidū, Parties, Structura, Maceria: נִדְבַּךְ דִּי אֶעָא חֲדַת Parties ex lignū novis; Plural. נִדְבְּכִין דִּי אֶבֶן גְּלַל Ordines murorum terni ex lapidibus magnis, Esra 6.4. Sic in Targ. נִדְבַּךְ עַל נִדְבַּךְ Ordo super ordine, Hebr. אֶבֶן עַל אֶבֶן Lapis super lapide, Hagg.2.15. נִדְבְּכִין עֲבִידֶן לְהוֹן Ordines lapidei

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-printed entries transcribed letter by letter; vowel points and small letters in the Chaldee lines are doubtful where marked [?]. "Ursro" is printed as it appears and may be a misprint for "Urso". The Hebrew of the first lines (צֹאַת, קְבָא) is uncertain. The last entry continues on the next page. The "Digitized by Google" watermark at bottom right is excluded.
